blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected all five regenerated V111 views and six poses. Stagewise edge tracing isolates the rear-neckline facets: edge 759-860 changes from 8.01511° after native sewing to 176.62925° at torso-contour; edge 759-1003 stays 3.21893° through upper-surface, then flips to 177.13795° at panel-interior-fairing. V111 is diagnostic-only; broad torso faceting remains visible and appearance is not accepted.

The garment remains almost entirely white with a narrow lavender diagonal band and sparse edge piping. Lamé material response is not visible in these current renders, and the intended fencing-practice identity is still weak.

Crouch/sit retain skirt and shorts overlap and abrupt hem deformation; prone remains a broad disk-like flare. Avatar fit, final skin weights, Shape Key response, validated UVs, Unity/VRChat execution and package eligibility remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
